cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Senior Laboratory Technician, Quality to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
You will perform routine and non-routine testing to support validation/revalidations of critical systems and sterilization equipment, identification of bacterial/fungal isolates, evaluation of inactivation rates of organisms, product resistance studies, prepares general test data summaries, trend charts, protocols and reports. You will also perform testing, per established standard operating procedures.
How you will make an impact:
Perform routine and non-routine testing within the department, as per established procedures. Perform data entry of routine and non-routine testing. Assist in testing validation/revalidation activities for critical systems and sterilization equipment with minimal supervision. Microbial identification and evaluation of inactivation rates of microorganisms. Prepare data summaries, protocols and reports using existing templates as a model. May generate inter-company memos using templates for areas such as sample request or to schedule studies. Initiate and support laboratory investigations and propose recommendations for manager view. Propose and update operating procedures and ensure that specifications are in compliance with GMP, Environment, and Safety regulations.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Microbiology or a related field (Biological Sciences, Biology, Chemistry, etc.)
2 Years' related laboratory technician experience
Knowledge of Good Manufacturing and Good Documentation Practices supporting a medical device environment
Strict attention to detail
Must be able to work in a team environment
Good verbal communication, interpersonal, and relationship building skills
Good writing skills
Preferred Requirements
Medical device industry or related industry experience, including aseptic techniques
Computer skills: Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel); LIMS experience strongly preferred
Ability to provide feedback in a professional, direct, and tactful manner

You will perform routine and non-routine testing to support validation/revalidations of critical systems and sterilization equipment, identification of bacterial/fungal isolates, evaluation of inactivation rates of organisms, product resistance studies, prepares general test data summaries, trend charts, protocols and reports. You will also perform testing, per established standard operating procedures.
How you will make an impact:
Perform routine and non-routine testing within the department, as per established procedures. Perform data entry of routine and non-routine testing. Assist in testing validation/revalidation activities for critical systems and sterilization equipment with minimal supervision. Microbial identification and evaluation of inactivation rates of microorganisms. Prepare data summaries, protocols and reports using existing templates as a model. May generate inter-company memos using templates for areas such as sample request or to schedule studies. Initiate and support laboratory investigations and propose recommendations for manager view. Propose and update operating procedures and ensure that specifications are in compliance with GMP, Environment, and Safety regulations.
cond_0012.requirements: Bachelor's degree in Microbiology or a related field (Biological Sciences, Biology, Chemistry, etc.), or equivalent practical experience. Around 2 years of related laboratory technician experience, or an equivalent combination of education and training. Experience in the medical device industry or a related industry is a plus, including familiarity with aseptic techniques. Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel); some experience with LIMS is helpful. Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, and to build working relationships with colleagues. Background in Good Manufacturing and Good Documentation Practices in a medical device environment. Willingness to pay close attention to detail. Openness to working collaboratively in a team setting. Ability to give and receive feedback in a professional and respectful way.

Your work will involve optimizing product development to impact patients around the world with pioneering technology. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with laboratory testing and quality processes.
cond_0023.responsibilities:
You will perform routine and non-routine testing to support validation/revalidations of critical systems and sterilization equipment, identification of bacterial/fungal isolates, evaluation of inactivation rates of organisms, product resistance studies, prepares general test data summaries, trend charts, protocols and reports. You will also perform testing, per established standard operating procedures.
How you will make an impact:
Perform routine and non-routine testing within the department, as per established procedures. Perform data entry of routine and non-routine testing. Assist in testing validation/revalidation activities for critical systems and sterilization equipment with minimal supervision. Microbial identification and evaluation of inactivation rates of microorganisms. Prepare data summaries, protocols and reports using existing templates as a model. May generate inter-company memos using templates for areas such as sample request or to schedule studies. Initiate and support laboratory investigations and propose recommendations for manager view. Propose and update operating procedures and ensure that specifications are in compliance with GMP, Environment, and Safety regulations.
cond_0023.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Microbiology or a related field (Biological Sciences, Biology, Chemistry, etc.)
2 Years' related laboratory technician experience
Knowledge of Good Manufacturing and Good Documentation Practices supporting a medical device environment
Good verbal communication, interpersonal, and relationship building skills
Good writing skills
Strict attention to detail
Must be able to work in a team environment
Ability to provide feedback in a professional, direct, and tactful manner
Preferred Requirements
Medical device industry or related industry experience, including aseptic techniques
Computer skills: Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel); LIMS experience strongly preferred

You will perform routine and non-routine testing to support validation/revalidations of critical systems and sterilization equipment, identification of bacterial/fungal isolates, evaluation of inactivation rates of organisms, product resistance studies, prepares general test data summaries, trend charts, protocols and reports. You will also perform testing, per established standard operating procedures.

Perform routine and non-routine testing within the department, as per established procedures. Perform data entry of routine and non-routine testing. May generate inter-company memos using templates for areas such as sample request or to schedule studies. Initiate and support laboratory investigations and propose recommendations for manager view. Strict attention to detail

Medical device industry or related industry experience, including aseptic techniques
Computer skills: Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel); LIMS experience strongly preferred

You will coordinate with various teams to support routine and non-routine testing for validation/revalidations of critical systems and sterilization equipment, identification of bacterial/fungal isolates, evaluation of inactivation rates of organisms, and product resistance studies. You will help prepare general test data summaries, trend charts, protocols, and reports, and carry out testing per established standard operating procedures.
How you will make an impact:
Carry out routine and non-routine testing within the department, as per established procedures.
Perform data entry of routine and non-routine testing.
Work alongside the team to assist in testing validation/revalidation activities for critical systems and sterilization equipment with minimal supervision.
Support microbial identification and evaluation of inactivation rates of microorganisms.
Help prepare data summaries, protocols, and reports using existing templates as a model.
May coordinate inter-company memos using templates for areas such as sample requests or to schedule studies.
Initiate and support laboratory investigations together with colleagues, and share recommendations for manager review.
Collaborate on updating operating procedures and help ensure that specifications are in compliance with GMP, Environment, and Safety regulations.
cond_0360.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Microbiology or a related field (Biological Sciences, Biology, Chemistry, etc.)
2 Years' related laboratory technician experience.
Medical device industry or related industry preferred, including aseptic techniques.
Computer skills: Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel); LIMS experience strongly preferred.
Good verbal communication, interpersonal, and relationship building skills.
Good writing skills required.
Knowledge of Good Manufacturing and Good Documentation Practices supporting a medical device environment.
Strict attention to detail.
Must be able to work in a team environment.
Ability to provide feedback in a professional, direct, and tactful manner.

You will perform routine and non-routine testing to support validation/revalidations of critical systems and sterilization equipment, identification of bacterial/fungal isolates, evaluation of inactivation rates of organisms, product resistance studies, prepares general test data summaries, trend charts, protocols and reports. You will also perform testing, per established standard operating procedures.
How you will make an impact:
Perform routine and non-routine testing within the department, as per established procedures. Perform data entry of routine and non-routine testing. Assist in testing validation/revalidation activities for critical systems and sterilization equipment with minimal supervision. Microbial identification and evaluation of inactivation rates of microorganisms. Prepare data summaries, protocols and reports using existing templates as a model. May generate inter-company memos using templates for areas such as sample request or to schedule studies. Initiate and support laboratory investigations and propose recommendations for manager view. Propose and update operating procedures and ensure that specifications are in compliance with GMP, Environment, and Safety regulations.
cond_0372.requirements: Bachelor's degree in Microbiology or a related field (Biological Sciences, Biology, Chemistry, etc.), or equivalent practical experience. Around 2 years of related laboratory technician experience, or an equivalent combination of education and training. Experience in the medical device industry or a related industry is a plus, including familiarity with aseptic techniques. Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel); some experience with LIMS is helpful. Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, and to build working relationships with colleagues. Background in Good Manufacturing and Good Documentation Practices in a medical device environment. Willingness to pay close attention to detail. Openness to working collaboratively in a team setting. Ability to give and receive feedback in a professional and respectful way.

Your work will involve optimizing product development to impact patients around the world with pioneering technology.

cond_0501.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Laboratory Technician, Quality to join our team at [Company name masked]. Our Quality teams help shape the development of groundbreaking technologies to ensure each stage of our innovation process is held to the highest standards of integrity and safety. You'll partner closely with various teams, regularly communicating and sharing input on decisions across a product's entire lifecycle. The role involves optimizing product development and staying in active contact with colleagues across departments.
You will perform routine and non-routine testing to support validation/revalidations of critical systems and sterilization equipment, identification of bacterial/fungal isolates, evaluation of inactivation rates of organisms, product resistance studies, and prepare general test data summaries, trend charts, protocols and reports. You will also perform testing per established standard operating procedures.
cond_0501.responsibilities:
Perform routine and non-routine testing within the department, as per established procedures.
Perform data entry of routine and non-routine testing.
Work closely with colleagues to assist in testing validation/revalidation activities for critical systems and sterilization equipment with minimal supervision.
Microbial identification and evaluation of inactivation rates of microorganisms.
Prepare data summaries, protocols and reports using existing templates as a model.
May generate inter-company memos using templates for areas such as sample request or to schedule studies, initiating contact with relevant teams as needed.
Actively initiate and support laboratory investigations, propose recommendations, and communicate findings to your manager.
Propose and update operating procedures and ensure that specifications are in compliance with GMP, Environment, and Safety regulations, raising issues early when gaps are identified.

Bachelor's degree in Microbiology or a related field (Biological Sciences, Biology, Chemistry, etc.).
2 Years' related laboratory technician experience.
Medical device industry or related industry preferred, including aseptic techniques.
Computer skills: Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel); LIMS experience strongly preferred.
Good verbal communication, interpersonal, and relationship building skills.
Good writing skills required.
Knowledge of Good Manufacturing and Good Documentation Practices supporting a medical device environment.
Strict attention to detail.

You will perform routine and non-routine testing to support validation/revalidations of critical systems and sterilization equipment, identification of bacterial/fungal isolates, evaluation of inactivation rates of organisms, product resistance studies, prepares general test data summaries, trend charts, protocols and reports. You will also perform testing, per established standard operating procedures.
How you will make an impact:
Perform routine and non-routine testing within the department, as per established procedures. Perform data entry of routine and non-routine testing. Assist in testing validation/revalidation activities for critical systems and sterilization equipment with minimal supervision. Microbial identification and evaluation of inactivation rates of microorganisms. Prepare data summaries, protocols and reports using existing templates as a model. May generate inter-company memos using templates for areas such as sample request or to schedule studies. Initiate and support laboratory investigations and propose recommendations for manager view. Propose and update operating procedures and ensure that specifications are in compliance with GMP, Environment, and Safety regulations.
cond_0569.requirements: Bachelor's degree in Microbiology or a related field (Biological Sciences, Biology, Chemistry, etc.) required; advanced degree strongly preferred. Minimum 2 years of demonstrated expertise in a laboratory technician role. Medical device industry or related industry background strongly preferred, including proven proficiency in aseptic techniques. Deep knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel); substantial LIMS expertise strongly preferred. Exceptional verbal communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills. Strong writing skills required. Advanced knowledge of Good Manufacturing and Good Documentation Practices supporting a medical device environment. Strict attention to detail. Proven ability to work effectively in a team environment. Strong ability to provide feedback in a professional, direct, and tactful manner.

cond_0595.intro: We are looking for a Senior Laboratory Technician, Quality to join our team.
cond_0595.responsibilities:
You will perform routine and non-routine testing to support validation/revalidations of critical systems and sterilization equipment, identification of bacterial/fungal isolates, evaluation of inactivation rates of organisms, product resistance studies, prepares general test data summaries, trend charts, protocols and reports. You will also perform testing, per established standard operating procedures.
How you will make an impact:
Perform routine and non-routine testing within the department, as per established procedures. Perform data entry of routine and non-routine testing. Assist in testing validation/revalidation activities for critical systems and sterilization equipment with minimal supervision. Microbial identification and evaluation of inactivation rates of microorganisms. Prepare data summaries, protocols and reports using existing templates as a model. May generate inter-company memos using templates for areas such as sample request or to schedule studies. Initiate and support laboratory investigations and propose recommendations for manager view. Propose and update operating procedures and ensure that specifications are in compliance with GMP, Environment, and Safety regulations.
cond_0595.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Microbiology or a related field (Biological Sciences, Biology, Chemistry, etc.)
2 Years' related laboratory technician experience
Knowledge of Good Manufacturing and Good Documentation Practices supporting a medical device environment
Strict attention to detail
Must be able to work in a team environment
Good verbal communication, interpersonal, and relationship building skills
Good writing skills
Preferred Requirements
Medical device industry or related industry experience, including aseptic techniques
Computer skills: Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel); LIMS experience strongly preferred
Ability to provide feedback in a professional, direct, and tactful manner
